translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhang Jun left the Secretariat to become right vice director, Gao Shao, a judge on the staff of the Founder of Liang, had the Founder's yin request an initial appointment for a son. Every provincial ministry said there was no precedent, but Zhang Jun bent the rules to carry it out. His order was extremely urgent, and the clerks were terrified.

sentences.zh: 頃判云：「僕射未集郎官，赴省上指揮公事，且非南宮舊儀。

translations.literal: Qing judged: "Vice Director has not assembled bureau officials, going to ministry to present ordered public affairs—and moreover not southern palace old ceremony."
translations.idiomatic: Qing wrote in his decision: "The vice director has not assembled the bureau officials, yet goes to the ministry to deliver an ordered matter of public business—this is not the old procedure of the Southern Palace."

sentences.zh: 」浚聞之，慚悚致謝，頃由是知名，梁祖亦獎之。

translations.literal: " When Jun heard of it, he felt ashamed and fearful and offered thanks; Qing thereby became renowned, and the Liang founder also praised him.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Jun heard of this, he was ashamed and alarmed and offered his thanks. Qing thereby gained a reputation, and the Liang founder also commended him.

sentences.zh: 頃入梁，曆給諫、御史中丞、禮部侍郎、知貢舉，咸有能名。

translations.literal: Qing entered Liang and served successively as Supervising Secretary, Censor-in-Chief, Vice Minister of Rites, and Director of the Examinations; in all he had a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Liang he served in succession as supervising secretary, censor-in-chief, vice minister of rites, and director of the civil examinations, earning a name for competence at each post.

sentences.zh: 自吏部侍郎拜中書門下平章事，與李琪同輔梁室，事多矛盾。

translations.literal: From Vice Minister of Personnel he was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery; together with Li Qi he assisted the Liang house, and their affairs were often at odds.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted from vice minister of personnel to grand councilor, he served the Liang court alongside Li Qi, and the two often clashed.

sentences.zh: 莊宗入汴，頃坐貶登州司戶，量移濮州司馬。

translations.literal: When Zhuangzong entered Bian, Qing was demoted and appointed Registrar of Deng Prefecture, then transferred by degree to Vice Prefect of Pu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhuangzong took Bian, Qing was demoted to registrar of Deng Prefecture and soon transferred to vice prefect of Pu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 數年，遷太子賓客。

translations.literal: After several years he was transferred to Guest of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later he was appointed guest of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 天成初，為禮部尚書、太常卿、太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng he served as Minister of Rites, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tiancheng era he became minister of rites and director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then retired as junior guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 卒時年六十九。

translations.literal: When he died he was sixty-nine years old.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 輟朝一日，贈太子少師。

translations.literal: Court was suspended for one day, and he was posthumously granted Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The court suspended audiences for one day, and he was posthumously granted the title junior tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：夫相輔之才，從古難得，蓋文學政事，履行謀猷，不可缺一故也。

translations.literal: The historiographer states: Talent for assisting in government has from antiquity been hard to obtain, for literary learning and administrative affairs, conduct and stratagems, cannot lack any one of them.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer remarks: Men fit to serve as chief ministers have always been rare, because literary learning, administrative skill, personal conduct, and strategic counsel are alike indispensable.

sentences.zh: 如數君子者，皆互有所長，亦近代之良相也。

translations.literal: Men such as these several gentlemen each had strengths in turn and were also fine ministers of recent times.
translations.idiomatic: The gentlemen treated here each excelled in different respects and may be counted among the worthy ministers of recent times.

sentences.zh: 如齊公之明節，李琪之文章，足以圭表搢紳，笙簧典誥，陟之廊廟，宜無愧焉！

translations.literal: Such as Duke Qi's bright integrity and Li Qi's literary compositions—sufficient to be a jade measure for the gentry and to sound through canonical edicts—when raised to the hall of state, they should have no shame!
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Qi's luminous integrity and Li Qi's literary mastery were enough to set a standard for the gentry and to lend grace to state documents; when such men entered the highest councils of government, they had nothing to be ashamed of!
